reviews.shade: [Limited] Cell Fusion C Dark Spot Toning Sunscreen 35ml Triple Set
reviews.text: 2nd time purchase. No eye sting, no need foundation, high SPF/PA, no irritation, smooth texture, suitable for my skin.
reviews.zh: 第二次購買。唔會令眼睛刺痛，唔使搽粉底都得，SPF/PA 數值高，冇刺激，質地順滑，啱我嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: [Limited] Cell Fusion C Dark Spot Toning Sunscreen 35ml Triple Set
reviews.text: I love the value packs, and its very nice Sunscreen which i will definitely use whole summer ☀️
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢啲超值裝，係好好用嘅防曬，夏天成個季節都會用 ☀️

reviews.shade: [Limited] Cell Fusion C Dark Spot Toning Sunscreen 35ml Triple Set
reviews.text: Bought this in early April 2026 when i was in Seoul.. the texture is not too runny but still easily applied on my skin.. it does tone up and brighten my skintone and I usually use it on weekend.. What I’m most glad is that it doesn’t ruin my skin (very sensitive skin).Im deducting 1 star because it doesn’t give bluring effect unlike the beplain.
reviews.zh: 我係 2026 年四月初喺首爾買嘅……質地唔會太稀，但塗喺皮膚上都好易推開……會提亮膚色，我通常係週末先用……最慶幸嘅係佢唔會搞壞我嘅皮膚（我嘅皮膚好敏感）。我扣咗一粒星，因為佢冇好似 beplain 咁嘅模糊效果。

reviews.shade: [Limited] Cell Fusion C Dark Spot Toning Sunscreen 35ml Triple Set
reviews.text: It’s 10 out of 10 it lives white Cast, but like it melts in skin and it keeps another level of glow
reviews.zh: 滿分 10 分。佢 lives white Cast，不過會融入皮膚，仲可以帶出另一個層次嘅光澤。

reviews.shade: [Limited] Cell Fusion C Dark Spot Toning Sunscreen 35ml Triple Set
reviews.text: 色素沈着やシミに効いたらいいなという理由で購入。カラーが付いているが、肌をカバーするほどのカバー力はない。所詮日焼け止め。日焼け止めとケアが同時にできるところがいいと思うので効果次第ではある。
reviews.zh: 因為希望對色素沉澱同斑點有效而購買。雖然有顏色，但遮瑕力唔足以遮蓋肌膚。始終都只係防曬霜。我覺得可以同時防曬同護膚係優點，所以要視乎效果而定。

reviews.shade: [Limited] Cell Fusion C Dark Spot Toning Sunscreen 35ml Triple Set
reviews.text: I really like this sunscreen. The finish feels nice and looks nice. Smells very light and comfortable too, i normally don’t like strong fragrance
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款防曬。完成之後嘅質感摸落好舒服，睇落都好。味道好淡，用落都舒服，我平時都唔太鍾意味道濃嘅產品。

reviews.shade: [Limited] Cell Fusion C Dark Spot Toning Sunscreen 35ml Triple Set
reviews.text: It's a silky product. I will buy it again.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品好絲滑。我會再買。

reviews.shade: [Limited] Cell Fusion C Dark Spot Toning Sunscreen 35ml Triple Set
reviews.text: I have been using this sunblock for years. It’s gives you the coverage and is light. Love it!
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款防曬好多年。有遮蓋力，而且好輕盈。好鍾意！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
